source_refs.note: Exercise 11.1, Question 1 (book page 205): even/odd test for 8 functions, parts (i)-(viii). Answer key PDF 309 agrees with all 8; solution book PDF 989-996.

blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\sin^2 x\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kya keh raha hai: humein batana hai ke \(f(x) = \sin^2 x\) even hai, odd hai ya dono mein se koi nahi (neither).
Is ka test hamesha ek hi hai: \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakho aur dekho ke jawab \(f(x)\) ke barabar aata hai, \(-f(x)\) ke barabar, ya kisi ke bhi nahi.
Plan: pehle \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\) lagayenge, phir square karenge. Square minus sign ko kha jata hai, yahi is sawal ki jaan hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sin^2 x\), jo har real \(x\) ke liye defined hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

\(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein
\[f(-x) = \sin^2(-x)\]
\[= \big(\sin(-x)\big)^2\]
\[= (-\sin x)^2\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 x\) ka matlab hai \((\sin x)^2\), yani pehle angle ka sine nikalo, phir us ka square karo. Is liye pehle andar wala \(\sin(-x)\) badla, jo \(-\sin x\) ban gaya kyunke sine odd function hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin^2(-x)\) ko \(-\sin^2 x\) likhna aam ghalti hai. Minus sign square ke andar hai, bahar nahi.

Simplify kar ke compare karein
\[(-\sin x)^2 = \sin^2 x\]
\[f(-x) = f(x)\]
Kyun: kisi bhi negative number ka square positive hota hai, jaise \((-3)^2 = 9\). Isi tarah \((-\sin x)^2 = \sin^2 x\). Hamein wapas bilkul wohi function mil gaya, is liye yeh even hai.

Tasdeeq (ek value se check)
\[f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^2 = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
\[f\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^2 = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: \(x\) aur \(-x\) par output ek jaisa aaya. Even function ka graph y-axis ke gird symmetric hota hai, yani left aur right taraf barabar unchai. Ek value proof nahi hoti, lekin hamare algebra ki tasdeeq zaroor karti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\sin x + \cos x\).
blocks.explanation:
Is function mein do terms hain: \(\sin x\) odd hai aur \(\cos x\) even hai. Sawal yeh hai ke dono ko jama karne se kya banta hai.
Plan: \(f(-x)\) nikalenge, phir us ko \(f(x)\) aur \(-f(x)\) dono se milayenge. Agar kisi se na mile to ek value rakh kar saabit kar denge ke yeh neither hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sin x + \cos x\), har real \(x\) ke liye defined.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

\(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein
\[f(-x) = \sin(-x) + \cos(-x)\]
\[= -\sin x + \cos x\]
Kyun: sine odd hai is liye us ka sign badal gaya, cosine even hai is liye woh waisa hi raha.

\(f(x)\) aur \(-f(x)\) se milayein
\[f(x) = \sin x + \cos x\]
\[-f(x) = -\sin x - \cos x\]
\(f(-x) = -\sin x + \cos x\) dono mein se kisi ke barabar nahi: \(f(x)\) se \(\sin x\) ke sign mein farq hai aur \(-f(x)\) se \(\cos x\) ke sign mein.
Kyun: even banne ke liye poora expression wapas wohi aana chahiye, aur odd banne ke liye poore expression ka sign ulta hona chahiye. Yahan aadha badla, aadha nahi, is liye na even na odd.
Dhyan dein: bohat se students kehte hain ke \(\sin x\) odd hai to poora function odd hai. Jama (sum) tab hi odd hota hai jab har term odd ho.

Ek value se pakka karein
\[f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt2} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt2} = \sqrt2\]
\[f\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) = -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt2} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt2} = 0\]
Kyun: \(0\) na \(\sqrt2\) ke barabar hai na \(-\sqrt2\) ke. Even ya odd ki shart har \(x\) ke liye sach honi chahiye; ek bhi \(x\) par toot jaye (counter-example, yani ulti misaal) to shart khatam. Is liye neither saabit ho gaya.
blocks.final_answer: \(\sin x + \cos x\) na even hai na odd (neither).

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\sin^4 x + \cos^4 x\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan dono terms ki power 4 hai, jo even power hai. Even power har minus sign ko khatam kar deti hai, is liye pehle se andaza hai ke jawab even aayega.
Plan: har term mein \(-x\) rakh kar alag alag simplify karenge aur phir \(f(x)\) se milayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sin^4 x + \cos^4 x\), har real \(x\) ke liye defined.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

\(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein
\[f(-x) = \sin^4(-x) + \cos^4(-x)\]
\[= (-\sin x)^4 + (\cos x)^4\]
Kyun: andar ka angle pehle badalta hai: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\) aur \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\). Power baad mein lagti hai.

Simplify kar ke compare karein
\[(-\sin x)^4 = \sin^4 x\]
\[f(-x) = \sin^4 x + \cos^4 x = f(x)\]
Kyun: negative number ki even power hamesha positive hoti hai, jaise \((-2)^4 = 16 = 2^4\). Char baar minus se multiply karein to minus do do kar ke cancel ho jate hain. Wapas poora \(f(x)\) mil gaya, yani function even hai.
Dhyan dein: agar power odd hoti (jaise 3), to minus sign bach jata. Is liye har sawal mein power ko ghaur se dekhiye.

Tasdeeq
\[f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = \dfrac{9}{16} + \dfrac{1}{16} = \dfrac{5}{8}\]
\[f\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = \dfrac{9}{16} + \dfrac{1}{16} = \dfrac{5}{8}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^4(\pm\pi/3) = (\sqrt3/2)^4 = 9/16\) aur \(\cos^4(\pm\pi/3) = (1/2)^4 = 1/16\). Dono taraf ek hi jawab aaya, jo even function ki pehchan hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\tan x + \sec x\).
blocks.explanation:
Is mein \(\tan x\) odd hai aur \(\sec x\) even hai. Bilkul part (ii) jaisi soorat hai: ek odd aur ek even ka jama, is liye andaza hai ke jawab neither hoga, lekin saabit karna zaroori hai.
Plan: \(f(-x)\) nikalenge, \(f(x)\) aur \(-f(x)\) se milayenge aur ek value se pakka karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \tan x + \sec x\), jo \(x \ne \pm\pi/2, \pm3\pi/2, \ldots\) par defined hai. Yeh domain 0 ke gird symmetric hai, yani agar \(x\) domain mein hai to \(-x\) bhi.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

\(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein
\[f(-x) = \tan(-x) + \sec(-x)\]
\[= -\tan x + \sec x\]
Kyun: tangent odd hai (sine odd aur cosine even, to un ka hissa \(\tan = \sin/\cos\) odd), aur secant even hai kyunke woh \(1/\cos\) hai.

Compare karein
\[f(x) = \tan x + \sec x\]
\[-f(x) = -\tan x - \sec x\]
\(f(-x) = -\tan x + \sec x\) in dono mein se kisi ke barabar nahi.
Kyun: sirf ek term ka sign badla. Even ke liye koi sign nahi badalna chahiye tha, odd ke liye dono badalne chahiye the.

Ek value se pakka karein
\[f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) = 1 + \sqrt2\]
\[f\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) = -1 + \sqrt2\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt2 - 1 \approx 0.41\) na \(2.41\) ke barabar hai na \(-2.41\) ke. Ek counter-example kaafi hai, kyunke even/odd ki shart har \(x\) par sach honi chahiye.
blocks.final_answer: \(\tan x + \sec x\) na even hai na odd (neither).

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec}^3 x}\).
blocks.explanation:
Pehle fraction ko aasaan bana lete hain: \(\operatorname{cosec} x = 1/\sin x\), is liye \(1/\operatorname{cosec}^3 x\) asal mein \(\sin^3 x\) hai.
Plan: phir \(-x\) rakh kar test karenge. Power 3 odd hai, is liye minus sign bachega aur jawab odd aana chahiye.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec}^3 x}\), jo wahan defined hai jahan \(\sin x \ne 0\), yani \(x \ne n\pi\). Yeh domain 0 ke gird symmetric hai, is liye test lagana jaiz hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

Function ko simplify karein
\[\operatorname{cosec} x = \dfrac{1}{\sin x}\]
\[f(x) = \sin^3 x\]
Kyun: cosecant sine ka reciprocal (ulta) hai. \(\operatorname{cosec}^3 x = 1/\sin^3 x\), aur ek ko is se divide karein to \(\sin^3 x\) bachta hai. Aasaan shakal mein test lagana kam ghalti wala hai.

\(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein
\[f(-x) = \sin^3(-x)\]
\[= (-\sin x)^3\]
\[= -\sin^3 x = -f(x)\]
Kyun: negative number ki odd power negative hi rehti hai, jaise \((-2)^3 = -8\). Teen minus mein se do cancel hote hain aur ek bach jata hai. Poore function ka sign ulta ho gaya, yani odd.
Dhyan dein: part (i) mein power 2 thi to minus khatam ho gaya tha; yahan power 3 hai to minus bach gaya. Power ka even ya odd hona hi faisla karta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^3 = \dfrac{1}{8}\]
\[f\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^3 = -\dfrac{1}{8}\]
Kyun: dono jawab ek doosre ke ulte (negative) hain. Odd function ka graph origin ke gird symmetric hota hai, aur yahi hum dekh rahe hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\frac{\sin x + \sin 3x}{\cos x + \cos 3x}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh fraction hai. Numerator (upar wala hissa) mein sirf sine hain jo odd hain, aur denominator (neeche wala hissa) mein sirf cosine hain jo even hain.
Plan: upar aur neeche ko alag alag \(-x\) par check karenge, phir divide karenge. Odd ko even se divide karein to odd banta hai, jaise \(-3/2\) aur \(3/2\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \frac{\sin x + \sin 3x}{\cos x + \cos 3x}\), jo wahan defined hai jahan \(\cos x + \cos 3x \ne 0\). Cosine even hai, is liye yeh shart \(x\) aur \(-x\) dono par ek jaisi hai: domain symmetric hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

Numerator mein \(-x\)
\[\sin(-x) + \sin(-3x)\]
\[= -\sin x - \sin 3x\]
\[= -(\sin x + \sin 3x)\]
Kyun: sine har angle ke liye odd hai; yahan angle \(3x\) hai, to \(\sin(-3x) = -\sin 3x\). Dono terms ka minus bahar nikal liya.

Denominator mein \(-x\)
\[\cos(-x) + \cos(-3x)\]
\[= \cos x + \cos 3x\]
Kyun: cosine even hai, is liye neeche wala hissa bilkul nahi badla.

Divide karein
\[f(-x) = \dfrac{-(\sin x + \sin 3x)}{\cos x + \cos 3x}\]
\[= -f(x)\]
Kyun: upar ka minus poore fraction ke aage aa jata hai. Is liye \(f(-x) = -f(x)\), yani odd.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin 3x\) ko \(3\sin x\) samajhna ghalat hai; hum use bilkul nahi khol rahe, sirf us ka sign dekh rahe hain.

Tasdeeq
\[f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \dfrac{\tfrac12 + 1}{\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2} + 0} = \sqrt3\]
\[f\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \dfrac{-\tfrac12 - 1}{\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2} + 0} = -\sqrt3\]
Kyun: \(\sin(\pi/2) = 1\) aur \(\cos(\pi/2) = 0\). Dono jawab ulte hain. Dilchasp baat: sum-to-product formulas se yeh function \(\tan 2x\) ban jata hai, jo khud odd hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vii) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\frac{1}{\sec x + \sec^3 x}\).
blocks.explanation:
Is function mein sirf secant hai, aur secant even hai (kyunke woh cosine ka ulta hai). Jis function mein sirf even cheezein hon, woh khud even hota hai.
Plan: denominator mein \(-x\) rakh kar dekhenge ke kuch badla ya nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{\sec x + \sec^3 x}\), jo wahan defined hai jahan \(\cos x \ne 0\). Denominator kabhi zero nahi hota, kyunke \(\sec x\) aur \(\sec^3 x\) ka sign hamesha ek jaisa hota hai. Domain 0 ke gird symmetric hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

\(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein
\[f(-x) = \dfrac{1}{\sec(-x) + \sec^3(-x)}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sec x + \sec^3 x}\]
Kyun: \(\sec(-x) = \frac{1}{\cos(-x)} = \frac{1}{\cos x} = \sec x\). Jab \(\sec\) hi nahi badla to us ka cube bhi nahi badlega, aur poora denominator waisa hi rahega.

Compare karein
\[f(-x) = f(x)\]
Kyun: wapas bilkul wohi expression mil gaya, is liye function even hai.
Dhyan dein: power 3 (odd) dekh kar ghabrayein nahi. Odd power sirf tab minus bachati hai jab andar minus ho; yahan \(\sec(-x)\) mein koi minus aata hi nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\sec\left(\pm\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = 2\]
\[f\left(\pm\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = \dfrac{1}{2 + 8} = \dfrac{1}{10}\]
Kyun: \(\cos(\pi/3) = 1/2\) is liye \(\sec = 2\) aur \(\sec^3 = 8\). \(\pi/3\) aur \(-\pi/3\) dono par ek hi jawab \(1/10\) aaya.

blocks.prompt: 1 (viii) Determine whether the following functions are even, odd or neither odd nor even: \(\frac{1}{\sec x + \cot^2 x}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(\sec x\) even hai. \(\cot x\) odd hai, lekin us ka square liya gaya hai, aur square minus ko khatam kar deta hai, is liye \(\cot^2 x\) even ban jata hai.
Plan: har term mein \(-x\) rakhenge aur dekhenge ke denominator waisa hi rehta hai ya nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{\sec x + \cot^2 x}\), jo wahan defined hai jahan \(\sec x\) aur \(\cot x\) mojood hon aur \(\sec x + \cot^2 x \ne 0\). Neeche dekhenge ke denominator even hai, is liye domain bhi 0 ke gird symmetric hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) even, odd ya neither.
Tareeqa: \(f\) even hai agar domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(-x) = f(x)\) ho, aur odd hai agar \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) ho. Hum \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhenge aur yeh rules lagayenge: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), \(\tan(-x) = -\tan x\), \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-x) = -\operatorname{cosec} x\), \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\). Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: sirf cos aur us ka ulta (reciprocal) sec even hain; baqi chaar odd hain.

\(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhein
\[f(-x) = \dfrac{1}{\sec(-x) + \cot^2(-x)}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sec x + (-\cot x)^2}\]
Kyun: secant even hai to \(\sec(-x) = \sec x\); cotangent odd hai to \(\cot(-x) = -\cot x\).

Simplify kar ke compare karein
\[(-\cot x)^2 = \cot^2 x\]
\[f(-x) = \dfrac{1}{\sec x + \cot^2 x} = f(x)\]
Kyun: square ne cotangent ka minus khatam kar diya. Ab dono terms wapas waise hi hain, is liye function even hai.
Dhyan dein: sirf yeh dekh kar ke \(\cot\) odd hai, poore function ko odd na keh dein. Hamesha power aur poora expression dekh kar faisla karein.

Tasdeeq
\[f\left(\pm\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = \dfrac{1}{2 + \tfrac13} = \dfrac{3}{7}\]
Kyun: \(\sec(\pm\pi/3) = 2\) aur \(\cot^2(\pm\pi/3) = (1/\sqrt3)^2 = 1/3\). Dono taraf \(3/7\) aaya, even function ki tasdeeq ho gayi.
